### Knowledge Topics
#### Unified Task Model
- Beginner explanation: Long-running work should have one durable state model, whether the target is a document or media source.
- Project usage: V3.6 uses target_type plus source_id/document_id so document ingestion and media processing share ingestion_jobs and job_events.
- Code locations: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `LICENSE`, `README.md`
- Review suggestion: Review task state machines, nullable foreign keys, retry/cancel semantics and worker dispatch.
- Interview expression: I unified document and media processing under one durable task model, so progress, events, retries and cancellation work consistently across modalities.

#### Release Verification
- Beginner explanation: A release package must be reproducible and must not include dependencies, caches, secrets or user data.
- Project usage: V3.6 keeps release.py exclusion rules and adds tests/checks for forbidden archive entries.
- Code locations: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `LICENSE`, `README.md`
- Review suggestion: Review zip packaging, SHA256 checks, exclusion rules and acceptance reports.
- Interview expression: I treated release packaging as part of the product boundary, verifying that generated archives exclude secrets, databases, uploads and build caches.
